text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make three. Saw 40 mm lengths of 35 x 12 mm aluminium bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 120 degree V the full 40 mm length of one 40 x 35 face:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 27.7 mm wide at the face, 8 mm deep, centred. Saw just inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the scribed lines and file to them; 4 mm of solid stays above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 4.2 mm and tap M5, 8 mm deep, in the flat top face, on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line, 8 mm from each end (24 mm apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue a 1.5 mm strip of rubber sheet into the V, both faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the V sits on the down tube, the tray on its flat top; two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M5 countersunk screws down through the tray hold it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tubes of 28 to 32 mm seat on both faces of the V.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a 32 mm tube it does not rock, and the tube does not

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: touch the bottom of the V.
